title: Endgame Accelerator Pursuit Log - Owen
content:
Date: 2026-12-20
Owner: Owen Brooks (AE) — daily scratchpad for end-of-quarter closing plays. Quick reference and live notes during calls.

Goal (EoQ): Convert 3 targeted pilots to paid trials by 2026-12-31. Stretch: 5. Keep 1 mid-market demo for Jan follow-up.

Top priorities today:
- 9:00–11:30 — heavy outbound to BlockerTech, Meridian Health, DeltaScale (call -> leave message -> follow-up email).
- 13:00 — prep call w/ Marco (SE) for BlockerTech deep demo (need quantized perf numbers + latency SLO slide).
- 15:30 — finalize contract outline for Meridian (legal template + 30-day trial + PO cadence).
- End of day: update CRM, flag 3 hottest opps for SDR play.

Pipeline quick list (live notes):
1) BlockerTech | Champion: Priya Khanna (CTO) | Role: Platform | Last touch: 2026-12-18 discovery | TLDR: excited about cost-per-token math, wants numbers for 8k window and KV cache reuse. | Next: Demo 12/21 w/ Marco. Priority: P0. Notes: ask SE for perf with 4-bit quant at 8k context; show batching impact.
2) Meridian Health | Champion: Daniel Ortiz (Head of AI) | Role: Enterprise ML | Last touch: 2026-12-14 POC review | TLDR: compliance questions + private deployment option. | Next: send private deployment checklist + quote 12/20. Priority: P1. Notes: connect to privacy/legal; include HSM/KMS bullet.
3) DeltaScale | Champion: Katrina M. (Prod Lead) | Role: Latency-focused | Last touch: 2026-12-17 technical call | TLDR: wants sub-200ms cold-start SLO for chat product. | Next: follow-up email with routing + fallback policy examples. Priority: P1.
4) BrightCart | Champion: Marcus Li (VP Eng) | Role: Ecom | Last touch: 2026-12-10 inbound demo | TLDR: wants cost projection for embedding-based search at scale. | Next: price model granular sheet. Priority: P2.
5) Nova Legal | Champion: Elise Park (CISO) | Role: Security | Last touch: 2026-12-05 initial interest | TLDR: legal + audit logs are blockers. | Next: send compliance package + SOC2 excerpt. Priority: P2.
6) SmallPilot (internal) | Champion: Amy (PM) | Role: internal test | TLDR: quick smoke test of dedicated pool. | Next: confirm GPU SKU and schedule 12/22. Priority: P3.

Call plan / script snippets (short):
- Intro: "Hi <name>, Owen from Redwood Inference — quick check, did the perf numbers we sent line up with your expectations? If not, one quick demo now or tomorrow can show real tokens/savings in 10 minutes."
- Voicemail leave: "Owen Brooks, Redwood Inference — short note: sent updated trial numbers and a two-option contract. Would love 10 minutes tomorrow to align. Call back x or email owen@redwood.ai."
- Email subject variants (A/B):
  A) "Pilot numbers + 10-min demo — BlockerTech/Redwood"
  B) "EoQ: trial terms + perf snapshot you asked for"

Common objections + short rebuttals (cheat sheet):
- "We host everything on prem" -> "We offer Private (VPC/on-prem) with customer-managed control plane and audit logs — happy to loop infra to review architecture."
- "Cost concerns" -> "Share batching + caching sim and expected unit costs at your 100 RPS pattern; propose short fixed-cost pilot to measure."
- "Latency / cold start" -> "Show smart routing and warm pool + KV cache numbers; can do a short spike with dedicated capacity to validate."

Open asks (to resolve today):
- From Marco (SE): need throughput numbers for 8k context with 4-bit quantization by 12/20 EOD.
- From Legal: Meridian wants NDA variant with specific clause on data residency — ping legal and capture changes.
- From Solutions Eng: prepare a 5-slide demo deck focused on routing/fallback and cost controls.

Prep checklist for 12/21 BlockerTech demo:
- Slide: perf table (4-bit quant vs FP16) + latency curves (cold vs warm).
- Short script: 7-minute live demo (3m gen, 2m embeddings search, 2m Q&A).
- Test run with Marco at 12/20 16:30.
- Confirm attendee list and their roles.

Daily TODO (check when done):
- [ ] Send Meridian private deployment checklist + price sheet.
- [ ] Upload perf numbers (SE deliverable) to CRM.
- [ ] Record call notes for BlockerTech immediately after demo.
- [ ] Update opp stage + add next-step date in CRM.
- [ ] Flag any legal blockers in Slack #legal-sales.

Notes to self / random friction points:
- Need a reusable snippet for "dedicated burst capacity" — legal/ops have questions about limits.
- Sales demo machine sometimes loses net during live demo -> ensure portable recorded video as backup.
- Consider a rapid A/B test for email subject lines across P0 opps this afternoon.

End-of-day metrics to report to manager:
- Calls placed: __ (fill)
- Demos scheduled: __
- Trials started: __
- Contracts drafted: __

Questions to follow up tomorrow:
- Can infra provide a one-off dedicated pool for DeltaScale spike (2 days)? Who owns cost?
- Is there a short legal template for 30-day pilots that includes data handling clause?

Quick wins nudges (use templates):
- Send "performance snapshot" email after every technical call (template id: SALES_PERF_V2).
- Use "trial-terms-30d" doc for quick contracting.

---
End notes: keep this doc lightweight — copy relevant bits into CRM/opp notes after calls. If anything is unclear ping Marco or Sofia.

Unresolved: Meridian legal clause text, SE perf numbers, and who signs off on dedicated pool costs.
summary: Live AE scratchpad for EoQ accelerator pursuit; contains call list, scripts, open asks, and daily todo items.
